theorem ev_callPoly (P : Poly) (p w : ℕ) (g : Fin p → Poly) (x : ℕ → ℚ) :
    ev x (callPoly P p w g) =
      ev (fun i => if h : i < p then ev x (g ⟨i, h⟩) else x (w + (i - p))) P := by
